newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sets 1997 issue dates for economic reports.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sets 1997 issue dates for economic reports.

text.p: The U.S. Labor and Commerce Departments issued 1997 release dates for their major economic indicators as follows.
Jan 10 (Dec data), Feb 7 (Jan), March 7 (Feb), April 4 (March), May 2 (April), June 6 (May), July 3 (June), Aug 1 (July), Sept 5 (Aug), Oct 3 (Sept), Nov 7 (Oct) and Dec 5 (Nov).
LABOR DEPT. U.S. PRODUCER PRICE INDEX:
Jan 9 (Dec), Feb 14 (Jan), March 14 (Feb), April 11 (March), May 14 (April), June 13 (May), July 11 (June), Aug 13 (July), Sept 12 (Aug), Oct 10 (Sept), Nov 14 (Oct) and Dec 12 (Nov).
LABOR DEPT. U.S. CONSUMER PRICE INDEX:
Jan 14 (Dec data), Feb 19 (Jan), March 19 (Feb), April 15 (March), May 15 (April), June 17 (May), July 16 (June), Aug 14 (July), Sept 16 (Aug), Oct 16 (Sept), Nov 18 (Oct) and Dec 16 (Nov).
COMMERCE DEPT. U.S. GROSS DOMESTIC PRODUCT:

Jan 31 (advance Q4'96), Feb 28 (preliminary Q4 1996 data), March 28 (final Q4'96), April 30 (adv. Q1'97), May 30 (prelim. Q1'97), June 27 (final Q1'97), July 31 (adv. Q2'97), Aug 28 (prelim. Q2'97), Sept 26 (final Q2'97), Oct 31 (adv. Q3'97), Nov 26 (prelim. Q3'97), and Dec 23 (final Q3'97).
COMMERCE DEPT. INTERNATIONAL TRADE IN GOODS AND SERVICES:
Jan 17 (Nov data), Feb 19 (Dec), March 20 (Jan), April 17 (Feb), May 21 (March), June 19 (April), July 18 (May), Aug 20 (June), Sept 18 (July), Oct 21 (Aug), Nov 20 (Sept), and Dec 18 (Oct).
